description: Second-hand clothes dealer, third stall in the north lane, West Market. Past seventy.
knows: that Xu Ping is chasing a silk robe that smells of a prescription
that he was the one who told him Ji Wan has musk
last_seen: his stall, the morning he cut the aconite
name: Cheng Shu
observed_not_explained: Says no silk of that grade passes through the second-hand lane at all, and he would have costed it if it had.
toward_player: Amused by him. Enjoys being consulted. No loyalty either way.
voice: Prices things aloud whether or not they are for sale. Not a tactic — a condition. Valued Xu Ping's own robe twice in one conversation.
